name: Blimp
summary: Blimp airship in side view with an oval envelope, tail fins and a small blank gondola; for sky and travel scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom of the gondola stands on y; the airship floats in the air

params.name: s
params.note: scale: about 940 px wide and 690 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: fly = gentle float up and down

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the blimp faces left

author: krakujs
